purpose: Historical output/configuration comparison, not a new benchmark or a same-quality speedup claim

runtime.note: These are the historical measured Windows NVIDIA portable environment identities, not a guarantee for arbitrary updated installations.

timing_scope: native history graph wall and receiver-observed node wall; controller separately includes startup/checks; no GPU-compute or service-performance claim

hero_test_conditions.service_lifecycle: Separate newly started service for each row
hero_test_conditions.conditioning: Precomputed text embeddings reused; text encoding excluded from both table columns
hero_test_conditions.file_cache: Asset SHA checks read model files before inference; cold filesystem cache is not established
hero_test_conditions.offload: Synchronous; async offload, smart memory and pinned memory disabled
hero_test_conditions.current_quickstart_difference: Historical comparisons explicitly disable async offload; the maintained quickstart does not use that flag. These rows are not its measured latency.

bounce-audio.text: A single yellow tennis ball drops onto a wooden floor, bounces twice, and settles. Static camera, continuous shot. Audio: two soft impacts matching the visible bounces, with a quiet room background.

hands-face-mug.text: An adult sitting at a table slowly lifts a blue ceramic mug with both hands and gives a small smile. Static waist-up camera, continuous shot. Audio: a light ceramic sound as the mug leaves the table and a quiet room, no speech.

toycar.text: A small red toy car drives slowly from left to right across a wooden table. Static camera, continuous motion. Audio: a quiet motor hum.

media_render.comparison_mp4: CPU encoded, synchronized by source frame index, silent, three loops of 73 original frames, 219 frames at 24 fps = 9.125s; no motion interpolation
media_render.original_clip: 73 frames at 24 fps = about 3.04s, original clips contain audio
media_render.source_dimensions: 384x256 except toycar trim-8-576x384; that tile is resized only for the comparison
media_render.poster_caption_note: The generic 576x384 downscale footer applies only to that toycar tile, not the mug or ball groups

limits: Same seed does not ensure identical imagery across different models.
